items.title: I have 27 credit cards and CardPointers saves me hundreds of dollars: Here's what to know
items.why: Enthusiasts are paying attention to card-tracking tools, so a premium issuer app with built-in benefit tracking could win loyalty.
items.summary_ai: A Points Guy writer describes managing 27 credit cards with CardPointers and saving hundreds of dollars as a result.
